body_markdown:
It Changed My Life: School dropout cleans up his act – and becomes CEO.


“Na li die dao, na li pa” translates to picking oneself up if one falls to the floor.


Multiple failures, bankruptcy and jail terms could not stop CEO Vernon Kwek from slowing down. Climbing the corporate ladder from a toilet cleaner to CEO for the past 30 over years.


Read more on:[https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/school-dropout-cleans-up-his-act-and-becomes-ceo](https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/school-dropout-cleans-up-his-act-and-becomes-ceo)
